name: wp-v0-to-block-theme
description: Translate a v0 (Vercel) design — React/Next + Tailwind + shadcn/ui — into a WordPress block (FSE) theme: map Tailwind tokens to theme.json and shadcn/ui to core blocks, on top of the wp-design-to-block-theme capture, rebuild and parity workflow. Requires wp-design-to-block-theme.
